adultGuide.title: Expanding File Scene Chain Adult Guide
bullets: Set out the expanding file, blank page stack, pencils, and one labeled paper pocket before the adult-led story start: ____________________.
Choose one made-up scene chain card, then ask the child to keep every detail pretend and broad: ____________________.
Use each paper pocket for one page move: start scene, next scene, bridge detail, change marker, return detail, and file note: ____________________.
Keep the session offline and paper-only, with the adult holding the expanding file and guiding each page choice: ____________________.
Ask for invented characters, places, objects, and small changes; do not ask for personal facts or real day details: ____________________.
Close by tucking the page into the matching paper pocket and writing one adult-led restart note: ____________________.

sceneChainRoutines.title: Start Scene Pocket
sceneChainRoutines.materials: Expanding file, one blank page, pencil, and start-scene paper pocket.
steps: The adult opens the expanding file to the first paper pocket: ____________________.
The child names one made-up place, object, or character for the start scene: ____________________.
The adult asks what the pretend page should show first: ____________________.
The child writes or dictates one start scene line on the page: ____________________.
sceneChainRoutines.adultWrapLine: This scene chain begins with one pretend page detail: ____________________.

sceneChainRoutines.title: Next Scene Step
sceneChainRoutines.materials: Expanding file, current page, next blank page, and next-scene paper pocket.
steps: The adult points from the start scene pocket to the next scene pocket: ____________________.
The child chooses one small made-up action that follows the first page: ____________________.
The adult asks what should stay connected from the start scene: ____________________.
The child writes one next scene line that follows on paper: ____________________.
sceneChainRoutines.adultWrapLine: The next scene follows because the pretend action is: ____________________.

sceneChainRoutines.title: Bridge Detail Fold
sceneChainRoutines.materials: Folded paper strip, expanding file, two page notes, and bridge paper pocket.
steps: The adult places a folded bridge strip between two scene chain pages: ____________________.
The child chooses one pretend detail that connects both pages: ____________________.
The adult asks where that detail appears on the first page and the next page: ____________________.
The child writes the bridge detail on the folded strip: ____________________.
sceneChainRoutines.adultWrapLine: The bridge detail keeps the scene chain connected with: ____________________.

sceneChainRoutines.title: Change Marker Slip
sceneChainRoutines.materials: Small paper slip, pencil, expanding file, and change-marker paper pocket.
steps: The adult opens the change-marker paper pocket and rereads the current page note: ____________________.
The child invents one calm change in the pretend scene: ____________________.
The adult asks how the page looks slightly different after the change: ____________________.
The child writes the change marker on the slip and tucks it into the pocket: ____________________.
sceneChainRoutines.adultWrapLine: The made-up change marker for this scene chain is: ____________________.

sceneChainRoutines.title: Return Detail Page
sceneChainRoutines.materials: Earlier page, blank page, expanding file, and return-detail paper pocket.
steps: The adult opens an earlier page and asks which pretend detail can come back: ____________________.
The child picks one object, place clue, or character action from the scene chain: ____________________.
The adult places a blank page near the return-detail paper pocket: ____________________.
The child writes one return detail line that belongs on the new page: ____________________.
sceneChainRoutines.adultWrapLine: The return detail brings back this pretend piece: ____________________.

sceneChainRoutines.title: File Note Close
sceneChainRoutines.materials: Expanding file, page stack, file note slip, pencil, and final paper pocket.
steps: The adult lays the scene chain pages in order beside the expanding file: ____________________.
The child taps the page that should guide the next adult-led writing pass: ____________________.
The adult writes a file note that names the next pretend scene move: ____________________.
The child tucks the file note into the final paper pocket: ____________________.
sceneChainRoutines.adultWrapLine: The expanding file closes with this next page note: ____________________.

takeHomeSceneSlips.title: Start Scene Slip
takeHomeSceneSlips.adultLine: Adult: open the first paper pocket and ask for one made-up scene starter: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.childLine: Child: my pretend start scene begins with: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.nextPageLine: Next page: add one detail that belongs after the start scene: ____________________.

takeHomeSceneSlips.title: Next Scene Slip
takeHomeSceneSlips.adultLine: Adult: point from the first page to the next paper pocket: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.childLine: Child: the next pretend thing that happens is: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.nextPageLine: Next page: write the action that follows this scene: ____________________.

takeHomeSceneSlips.title: Bridge Detail Slip
takeHomeSceneSlips.adultLine: Adult: place one folded bridge strip between two scene chain pages: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.childLine: Child: the bridge detail connecting both pages is: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.nextPageLine: Next page: use the bridge detail in one new line: ____________________.

takeHomeSceneSlips.title: Change Marker Slip
takeHomeSceneSlips.adultLine: Adult: ask what small made-up change happens in this pretend scene: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.nextPageLine: Next page: show what is different after the change: ____________________.

takeHomeSceneSlips.title: Return Detail Slip
takeHomeSceneSlips.adultLine: Adult: reread one earlier page and ask what pretend detail can return: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.nextPageLine: Next page: bring that detail back in a calm story line: ____________________.

takeHomeSceneSlips.title: Paper Pocket Order Slip
takeHomeSceneSlips.adultLine: Adult: lay the expanding file pockets in scene chain order: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.childLine: Child: the paper pocket I need next is: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.nextPageLine: Next page: tuck the finished page into that pocket: ____________________.

takeHomeSceneSlips.title: Object Carry Slip
takeHomeSceneSlips.adultLine: Adult: ask which pretend object should move from one page to the next: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.childLine: Child: the object I will carry forward is: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.nextPageLine: Next page: let that object help connect the scene chain: ____________________.

takeHomeSceneSlips.title: Place Clue Slip
takeHomeSceneSlips.adultLine: Adult: choose one made-up place clue that can stay steady across pages: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.childLine: Child: my pretend place clue is: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.nextPageLine: Next page: repeat the clue in a new paper-only scene: ____________________.

takeHomeSceneSlips.title: Character Action Slip
takeHomeSceneSlips.adultLine: Adult: ask what the pretend character does next on the page: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.nextPageLine: Next page: connect the action to the next scene chain step: ____________________.

takeHomeSceneSlips.title: File Note Slip
takeHomeSceneSlips.adultLine: Adult: write one restart note before closing the expanding file: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.childLine: Child: the next made-up page should begin with: ____________________.
takeHomeSceneSlips.nextPageLine: Next page: read the file note, then add one pretend scene line: ____________________.
